index.html.title: Business Owner Index | Founders & Company Directory
index.html.description: Find business founders, explore their companies and follow public sources. Browse Business Owner Index by industry, location or name. Published by AE Tax Advisors.
index.html.heading: Explore founders, companies and public sources
index.html.body:
Use the founder directory to browse growth profiles, additional business founder profiles and the historical founder reference library. These collections have different inclusion criteria; founding a company does not establish current ownership.

Compare industries, explore locations and review each record’s original sources. Use the profile update route to submit a correction or request consideration. AE Tax Advisors owns and publishes this directory; inclusion does not establish a client relationship.
